title: NBAComp — Autonomous NBA Betting Strategy Research & Paper-Trading Competition
description: Autonomous NBA betting-strategy research and paper-trading competition lab that cross-verifies real public data, turns public claims into testable hypotheses, backtests them against verified historical prices where those exist and forward-tests them where they do not. It runs 27 system-generated strategies (NBA-001 through NBA-027) with a $1,000 virtual bankroll each over a competition window of 2026-09-20 to 2027-09-19, staking at 25% Kelly capped at 3% per bet, collecting ESPN schedule, scores and current odds, the ESPN injury board, Kalshi public market data and NBA.com/stats team and player logs, and modeling chronological Elo (MOV-adjusted, with season carryover), rolling pace and efficiency totals and rest, back-to-back, road-trip and time-zone features. Signal-quality results are published as signal quality and never mixed into backtest or forward PnL records. As of the generated leaderboard at 2026-09-23T00:45:36Z the competition has genuinely not started: 25 of the 27 forward entries read status 'awaiting-opportunity' with 0 bets and a null win rate, one (NBA-026 SpreadSageSam) reads 'active (open bets)' with 4 pending and 0 settled, and one (NBA-002 PacePulsePete) reads 'quarantined (10 bet(s) flagged)' — the README states those ten NBA-002 totals bets were priced off rolling box-score data, are published on positions.html#quarantined and are never deleted — while all 27 backtest entries read 'no historical data'. The platform reports the absence rather than a zero. Paper trading only; no real money.
